title: Sri Lanka With Little Ones
summary: Family-paced and full of things to point at, from the hills around Kandy to a week on the south coast.

facts.detail: Kandy · Nuwara Eliya · Weerawila · Galle · Colombo
December to April, when the south coast is dry

includes.heading: What the journey includes.
includes.body: Everything below is arranged before you land, with shorter drives and rooms that have space to spread out. Flights and visas sit outside the plan, and we will say so clearly in the proposal.

items.title: Accommodation
items.body: Nine nights in family-friendly stays, from Myst by Cinnamon in Kandy to Jetwing Lighthouse in Galle and a last night at the Hilton Colombo.

items.title: Activities
items.body: A dance show in Kandy, the Botanical Gardens, pedal boats and pony rides at Lake Gregory, a tea factory visit and jeep safaris.

items.title: Meals
items.body: Breakfast every day, plus the meals that are part of a stay or a long drive. The rest stays open for wherever the children want to eat.

items.title: Transfers and driver
items.body: Airport pick-up and drop-off, and the same driver and vehicle throughout, with the drives kept short and the stops frequent.

itinerary.heading: The island, at their pace.
itinerary.lede: Open a day to see what it holds and where you sleep.

days.title: An Easy Start for the Family
days.body: The dance show’s fire-walkers thrill the kids; the Botanical Gardens have lawns to run on and a treetop bat colony.

photos.caption: The Temple of the Tooth, Kandy

days.title: Boats, Ponies and Cool Green Air
days.body: Lake Gregory brings pedal boats and pony rides, plus a tea factory visit, all at a family pace.

days.title: The Bit They’ll Never Forget
days.body: Safari. Jeep drives for elephants, deer and crocodiles, with pool time in between.

photos.caption: An elephant ahead of the jeep

days.title: Beach Days on the Coast
days.body: An easy, walkable fort with ice-cream stops one day, the beach and pool the next.

days.title: One Last City Night
days.body: A final city night for shopping, a good meal and a quick look around the capital.

days.title: Time to Fly Home
days.body: Short transfer to the airport for your flight home.

stay.name: Private transfer
stay.note: Colombo airport, timed to your flight.

timeAnswer: Ten days covers this route at a child’s pace. Shorter trips usually mean dropping a stop rather than adding driving.
